privacy.title: Privacy
privacy.p1: Photos are analysed in memory and never stored on the server.
privacy.p2: Location is optional and rounded to ~1 km before storage; precise coordinates are never logged.
privacy.p3: No audio is recorded without consent. Demo data can be fully reset at any time.
about.title: Impact & about
about.p1: Artisanal fishing feeds Mauritius, but catch records are still paper-based and marine information is scattered.
about.p2: Lamer Konekte gives fishers a Morisyen-first assistant: photograph the catch, confirm the species, record honest measurements, check sourced rules, and prepare declarations — even offline.
about.team: Team Ctrl200 — Gemma 4 hackathon, Multimodal Track, Blue Economy pillar.
limitation.permanent: Lamer Konekte provides AI-assisted catch documentation and informational guidance. Species suggestions and regulatory checks must be confirmed against official sources and by the fisher or an authorised officer.
marine.disclaimer: Marine forecasts are informational and may be incomplete near the coast. Confirm conditions through official local marine advisories before travelling.

assistant.title: Fishing rules
assistant.intro: Every rule below comes from the same regulatory data the app uses to check your catches. It works with no signal — nothing here needs a connection.
assistant.newerRules: The server has a newer version of the rules than this app has stored. Reconnect and reload to update.
assistant.rule.noVerifiedRule: No verified rule found for this species. Verify against the latest official fisheries notice before landing.
assistant.rule.mantleWarning: This limit is measured on the MANTLE, not total length. The app records total length, so this rule cannot be decided from what you logged — measure the mantle and verify.
assistant.guide.title: How to complete a declaration
assistant.guide.mockNote: DEMONSTRATION ONLY — this app cannot make a real government submission. It shows how the process would work.
assistant.guide.step1: Record each catch as you land it
assistant.guide.step1Body: Photo, confirm the species yourself, then enter the measured length. Works offline — records queue on your phone.
assistant.guide.step2: Check your log before the period ends
assistant.guide.step2Body: Make sure everything synced and no record is still waiting on your phone. Correct any species you got wrong.
assistant.guide.step3Body: Pick the dates. You will see the record count, species breakdown and total before anything is sent.
assistant.guide.step4Body: You get a reference number and a printable summary. In this demo the submission is simulated, and the receipt says so.

assistant.model.unsupportedTitle: This device cannot run the assistant offline
assistant.model.noWebgpu: This browser has no WebGPU support, which the on-device model needs. Chrome or Edge on a recent laptop or Android phone can run it.
assistant.model.noOpfs: This browser cannot store large files offline, so the model could not be kept between visits.
assistant.model.unsupportedFallback: Nothing is lost — the rules browser holds the same regulations and works with no signal at all.
assistant.model.offerBody: This downloads a language model to your device so you can ask questions with no signal. It is optional.
assistant.model.factSize: one-time download. Use Wi-Fi if you can — this is large on mobile data.
assistant.model.factOnce: Downloaded once, then kept on this device.
assistant.model.factTextOnly: Text only — it cannot look at photos.
assistant.model.factPrivate: Runs entirely on your device. Your questions never leave it.
assistant.model.lowStorage: This device may not have enough free space.
assistant.model.declineHint: If you skip this, the rules browser still answers size limits and closed seasons offline.
assistant.model.downloadingNote: You can keep using the rest of the app. Do not close this tab.
assistant.model.readyBody: The model is stored on this device. It works with no signal.
assistant.model.errorBody: The model could not be downloaded. Check your connection and try again, or use the rules browser instead.
assistant.chat.title: Ask a question
assistant.chat.ungroundedWarning: Not connected to the rules data yet. Answers here are unverified and may be wrong about Mauritian regulations — check the Rules tab for anything that matters.
assistant.chat.emptyHint: Ask anything. Answers are generated on this device.
assistant.chat.failed: That answer could not be generated.
assistant.chat.loadingNote: Loading the model into memory takes a few seconds.
assistant.chat.errorBody: The model is on this device but would not load. The rules browser still works.
assistant.chat.rulesPointer: For size limits and closed seasons, the Rules tab is the source of truth.
assistant.chat.groundedNote: Answers come only from this app's rules data, never from the model's own memory. Rule references are shown so you can check them yourself.
assistant.chat.outOfScope: I can only answer from this app's fisheries rules — size limits, closed seasons, the five species in the catalogue, and how to complete a declaration. I do not have information on that, so I would rather say so than guess.
assistant.chat.scopeSize: Minimum sizes — "what size can I keep an ourite?"
assistant.chat.scopeDeclaration: Declarations — "how do I submit my catches?"
pillars.title: Blue economy pillars
pillars.intro: Six national blue-economy pillars on one Gemma inference spine. Each pillar states where its data came from, how fresh it is, and what it does not cover.
pillars.offlineNote: Showing the pillar list stored in this app — the server could not be reached, so live/registered state may have changed since this build.
pillars.notFoundBody: Nothing is registered under this id:
pillars.notEnabledTitle: Registered, not enabled on this deployment
pillars.notEnabledBody: This pillar is declared but its implementation is not switched on here, so its endpoints answer 503 rather than returning partial output.
pillars.liveElsewhereBody: This pillar runs on the production routes rather than a pillar module — use the catch, log and declaration screens.
pillars.kind.sampleWarning: This is a stored sample, not current conditions.
pillars.kind.syntheticWarning: Generated data — not an observation of anything. Do not read these as real conditions.
pillars.coverageMissing: No coverage note supplied — this is a contract violation, treat the result as unverified.
pillars.badgeRefBody: Examples of each label, shown here for reference. These are not results from any pillar.
tourism.title: Site conditions
tourism.intro: Forecast sea state and wind for named reef and beach sites. Figures come from Open-Meteo; the suitability ratings are computed from fixed thresholds, not written by a model.
tourism.computedNote: Each rating below is calculated from the figures above against fixed thresholds. The threshold is shown so you can check the result yourself.
tourism.interpretationNote: Written by the language model from the figures above. It cannot change any measurement or rating. Not safety advice.
tourism.noInterpretation: No written brief available — the language model could not be reached. The figures and ratings above are unaffected.
tourism.noCache: No conditions stored on this device yet, and the server cannot be reached. Open this page once while online and it will stay readable offline.
energy.title: Wave and wind resource
energy.intro: Forecast wave and wind power density at candidate coastal points. Both figures are computed in Python from Open-Meteo values; the language model writes the commentary and cannot produce or change a number.
energy.formulasNote: Printed so you can re-derive any figure on this page by hand from the inputs shown beside it.
energy.interpretationNote: Written by the language model from the computed figures above. It cannot alter any figure. Not a yield assessment.
energy.noInterpretation: No written note available — the language model could not be reached. The computed figures above are unaffected.
energy.unavailable: Resource figures could not be loaded. This pillar needs the backend; there is no offline copy because a stale power figure would be misleading.
